HO00003379.title: Practical Magic 2
HO00003379.description: Starring Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman, Practical Magic 2 returns to a world steeped in moonlit mischief and powerful ancestral magic, as the Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all.

HO00003181.title: Pressure
HO00003181.description: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, the free world hanging in the balance, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

HO00003172.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
HO00003172.description: Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, Peter Parker has devoted himself entirely to protecting his city as a full-time Spider-Man.

HO00003344.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark (45th Anniversary)
HO00003344.description: The year is 1936. An archeology professor named Indiana Jones is venturing in the jungles of South America searching for a golden statue. Unfortunately, he sets off a deadly trap but miraculously escapes.

HO00002993.title: The Odyssey
HO00002993.description: Christopher Nolan’s next film, The Odyssey, is a mythic action epic shot across the world using brand new IMAX® film technology

HO00003387.title: The Death of Robin Hood
HO00003387.description: THE DEATH OF ROBIN HOOD is a darker reimagining of the classic Robin Hood tale

HO00003402.title: The Incomer
HO00003402.description: On an Orkney isle, siblings Isla and Sandy hunt birds and talk to mythical beings while fighting off outsiders. Their lives change when Daniel, an awkward official, arrives to relocate them.

HO00003304.title: The Dog Stars
HO00003304.description: Set in a post-apocalyptic world in which a virus has wiped out most of humanity, with survivors being terrorized by roaming scavengers called "Reapers." The protagonist is Hig, a pilot who survived the flu that killed everyone he knew, his wife included.

HO00003306.title: Fall 2
HO00003306.description: Overwhelmed by her sister Hunter's death, Jax (Slater) connects with Luce (Thomas), Hunter's fearless friend. To heal, they attempt the infamous plank walk of Mount Kwan in Thailand

HO00003301.title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
HO00003301.description: After years of slapdash sequels and waning fandom, the Camp Miasma slasher franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director (Hannah Einbinder, Hacks) for resurrection

HO00003371.title: Don't Look Back In Anger
HO00003371.description: “Don’t Look Back In Anger” charts Liam and Noel Gallagher’s triumphant reunion tour, Oasis Live ‘25, one of the most anticipated rock ‘n’ roll comebacks of our time

HO00003390.title: The Summer Book
HO00003390.description: Follows the inspirational tale of a young girl and her grandmother spending a summer on a small, uninhabited island in the Gulf of Finland.

HO00003266.title: EXHIBITION ON SCREEN: James McNeill Whistler
HO00003266.description: In an era of great change and great beauty emerged the character of James McNeill Whistler. Considered by some to be one of the great innovators of 19th century art, he was a contemporary of the Impressionists, much admired by Van Gogh and Manet

HO00003427.title: Unidentified Murder (Cantonese)
HO00003427.description:
Alien Alert!!!
An influencer couple staged a harmless prank in pursuit of clicks and likes. Little do they know, their little escapade has gone out of control and spiralled into a real tragedy

HO00000748.title: The Gruffalo - 25th Anniversary
HO00000748.description:
A cunning mouse goes for a walk in the forest, and outwits a succession of predators.

This well-loved children's story celebrates its 25th anniversary this year.

HO00003359.title: Laputa: Castle in the Sky (Subbed) (40th Anniversary)
HO00003359.description: Pazu's life changes when he meets Sheeta, a girl whom pirates are chasing for her crystal amulet, which has the potential to locate Laputa, a legendary castle floating in the sky.

HO00002925.title: NT Live: Les Liaisons Dangereuses
HO00002925.description: Olivier and Tony® Award winner Lesley Manville joins Aidan Turner in a striking new staging of Christopher Hampton’s celebrated adaptation of the classic novel, where among the glittering salons of the super-rich, one misstep can mean ruin.

HO00003331.title: The Transformers: The Movie (40th Anniversary)
HO00003331.description: Forty years later, it still hits like a truck. Experience THE TRANSFORMERS: THE MOVIE back on the big screen in 4K and relive the battle, the music and THE moment...

HO00003418.description: From the mind of visionary filmmaker Zach Cregger (Weapons, Barbarian) comes a thrilling — and terrifying — reinvention of the Resident Evil franchise

HO00003182.description: Everyone is looking forward to Halloween on Mossy Bottom Farm - until the clumsy Farmer trashes the Flock's beloved pumpkin patch! But when Shaun turns MAD SCIENTIST to fix the problem, things rapidly spiral out of control

HO00003432.title: Whisper of the Heart (Subbed)
HO00003432.description: Discover the brilliance of this heart warming coming-of-age classic from the legendary Studio Ghibli, creators of My Neighbour Totoro and the Academy Award®-winning Spirited Away

HO00003437.description: When his twin sister April (Lilly Krug) goes missing, Bax (Connor Storrie) searches every corner of their futuristic, post-Soviet cityscape to find her, ultimately descending into madness.

HO00003406.description: The story begins when ace private eye Harry Goodman goes mysteriously missing, prompting his 21-year-old son Tim to find out what happened. Aiding in the investigation is Harry’s former Pokémon partner, Detective Pikachu.

HO00003385.description:
After 100 years of partial independence, a bold new wave of young Irish artists redefine folk
music and reflect over the impact of their colonial history.

HO00003272.description: Award-winner Sandra Oh (Killing Eve) plays the title role in this razor-sharp reimagining of Molière’s classic dark comedy. Telling the truth isn’t always that simple. Alice, a brilliant novelist, despises the carefully constructed lies of modern society
